purpose: Source-reported inputs to a separately identified landing-board circuit redesign
notes: Manufacturer pages were read and transcribed; their links do not create a verified datasheet claim.
Source dimensions and ratings remain distinct from design choices and conditional calculations.
The saved reference-board artifact and its fingerprints are not overwritten or reused for this redesign.

facts.name: IC output current rating
facts.scope: IC operating rating, not board or USB capability

facts.name: Optional feedforward with 100 kohm lower resistor
Layout
facts.paraphrase: Keep power loops compact and wide; keep feedback away from the switch node; join capacitor returns to power ground.

limitations: Do not copy the reference design's power-good discussion into the five-pin DBV part, which has no PG terminal.
The EVM is nominally 1.8 V; manufacturer EVM results are not measurements of this redesign.

sources.drawing_review: Visually inspected manufacturer drawing through browser on 2026-10-09

facts.name: Packaging suffix
facts.paraphrase: B was the less-than-full-reel packaging suffix; Coilcraft directs new orders to C.

facts.name: Bias network
facts.topology: EN and VREF2 join on bias node fed through resistor from high rail; VREF1 joins low rail.

facts.name: Bias current caveat
facts.paraphrase: The reference arrangement can inject current into VREF1 when its rail is unloaded.

limitations: The translator is not galvanic isolation, a USB interface, or proof of external-bus timing.

facts.name: Pull-up calculation
facts.paraphrase: Pull-up resistance must satisfy both low-level sink-current and rise-time/capacitance limits.

facts.name: Supply capability recommendation
facts.scope: Required source capability, not module maximum consumption or USB entitlement

design_choices.name: Feedback divider
design_choices.limits: Real resistor MPN/tolerance and dynamic output bounds remain unverified.

design_choices.name: Derived inductor pad centers
design_choices.derivation: Symmetric centers from manufacturer 2.37 mm spacing; long pad axis is Y.

attachment_conflicts: The supplied summary claims 34 references and 152 lands, but its entries contain five references and 19 lands.
The attachment TLV62569 assignments conflict with manufacturer DBV pin functions.
The attachment's Bourns footprint and 1.5 by 4.0 mm lands do not establish a Coilcraft physical fit.
The copied artifact fingerprints cannot identify changed parts, placements or nets.
USB data pins cannot simply become the proposed external I2C interface; an explicit separate header is required.
remaining_limits: No independent source relocation or manufacturing release approval.
No measured or simulated switching stability, startup, ripple or RF load-transient acceptance.
No verified USB current entitlement, complete board power budget or external-port load budget.
No verified thermal, EMC, antenna performance or physical-fit acceptance.
No confirmed MLCC effective capacitance under voltage and temperature, or resistor production tolerances.
External I2C cable capacitance, attached pull-ups, sink-current budget, ESD and hot-plug behavior remain unspecified.
